name: EG Industries Berhad
summary: EG Industries Berhad, an investment holding company, provides electronic manufacturing services primarily in Malaysia, the United States, Europe, Thailand, and internationally. It provides manufacturing services for computer peripherals, consumer electronic and electrical products, filtration face masks, automotive industrial products, and telecommunication products industries.
